kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-baseline --baseline-name BaselineName --project-id 10000 --owner 1000000000001 --priority 13578 --overtime-settings Time=00:00 Cycle=1 --baseline-type DAILY --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateBaseline

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace Management page to view the ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID，您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间管理页面查看ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the baseline owner
parameters.name: owner

parameters.help_en: The priority of the baseline. Valid values: 1, 3, 5, 7, and 8
parameters.help_zh: 基线的优先级，取值范围为{1,3,5,7,8}
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en: The upstream nodes of the baseline
parameters.name: node_ids

fields.help_en: The cycle corresponding to the committed time. Set this parameter to 1 for a daily baseline. For an hourly baseline, you can configure up to 24 cycles
fields.help_zh: 承诺时间对应的周期，天基线需要配置为1，小时基线可以配置最多24个周期
fields.name: cycle

fields.help_en: The committed time in the hh:mm format. The valid values for hh are [0,47], and the valid values for mm are [0,59]
fields.help_zh: 承诺时间，hh:mm格式，hh的取值范围为[0,47]，mm的取值范围为[0,59]
fields.name: time

parameters.help_en: The committed time configuration of the baseline
parameters.name: overtime_settings

parameters.help_en: The alert margin for the baseline, in minutes
parameters.help_zh: 基线预警余量，单位为分钟
parameters.name: alert_margin_threshold

parameters.help_en: The type of the baseline. Valid values: DAILY (daily baseline) and HOURLY (hourly baseline)
parameters.help_zh: 基线类型，包括DAILY（天基线）和HOURLY（小时基线）
parameters.name: baseline_type

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。取值如下：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
